description: This file defines the 'JsonApi' class implementing a JSON API response handler within the SuiteCRM project. It includes constants, properties, and methods related to JSON API response formatting and logging.

classes.name: JsonApi
classes.description: A class that provides JSON API response formatting, integrates with PSR Loggers, and defines the JSON API version.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a PSR Logger instance to be used by the JsonApi class.

methods.name: getSchemaPath
methods.description: Returns the file path to the JSON Schema file used for validating responses.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Returns an array representing the JSON API response with version information.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a logger instance on the object.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Returns the JSON API response array.
